exceptions.reason: Pre-existing oversized global stylesheet and mojibake debt; Phase 1 and later migrations must reduce this, not add to it.

Phase 0 temporarily accepts public visual-repair selectors in src/app/globals.css for base dark body, landing shell backgrounds, hero massive text suppression, public guide shell/state cards, and marquee continuity/hover cleanup. These are frozen migration debt and must be extracted into foundations/public-site modules in Phase 1/3 rather than extended.
Authenticated product routes are not reviewed as visual baselines until an auth fixture exists; Phase 0 uses a reviewed public-route baseline only.
